description: Get what is popular on Steam right now as a ranked list. `chart` picks one: top_sellers (weekly best-sellers, with weeks on chart), most_played (top 100 by peak players on the last full day, with the rank a week earlier) or concurrent_players (top 100 by players in game right now, live). Use for 'what's hot / top selling / most played on Steam'; for one known game's live count use get_current_players, for the store front page's curated sections (also hardware and bundles) use get_featured, to FILTER the catalog by discount, tags or compat use discover_games. Returns only rank, appid, name, store_url and chart metrics (no price/reviews/Deck status) — pass the appids to get_items for those. `last_week_rank` null means a new entry; concurrent_players has none. Player-chart names come from a best-effort lookup and may be null. Results are cached for a few minutes. All three are global rankings (the same in every country). No API key required.

chart.description: top_sellers = weekly best-sellers; most_played = yesterday's peak players; concurrent_players = live players now.

limit.description: How many top entries to return (1-100). Default 20.

name: get_charts

as_of.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the chart: start of the week (top_sellers), start of the day the peak was measured (most_played) or last live update (concurrent_players).

consecutive_weeks.description: Consecutive weeks on the weekly top-sellers chart, counting this one.

last_week_rank.description: Rank one week earlier; null means the game was not on this chart then (new entry).

name.description: Game name; null when Steam did not resolve one (best-effort for the player charts).
